dishes.name: Morteau sausage
dishes.desc: Smoked pork sausage from the Haut-Doubs, simmered and served with potatoes or in a potée. A staple in Besançon's restaurants and charcuteries.

dishes.name: Cancoillotte
dishes.desc: Soft, runny cheese spread made from cow's milk, butter and water, eaten warm on potatoes, ham or bread. Besançon and Franche-Comté's own cheese.

dishes.name: Comté
dishes.desc: Pressed cooked cheese from raw cow's milk, creamy, aromatic and a little spicy. Made across the Jura and Doubs and sold everywhere in Besançon.

dishes.name: Griotte bisontine
dishes.desc: Small cherries coated in dark chocolate, a sweet long tied to Besançon. Sold in the town's chocolate shops.

dishes.name: Chicken, vin jaune, morels
dishes.local: Poulet au vin jaune et aux morilles
dishes.desc: Free-range chicken cooked with vin jaune, cream, shallots and morel mushrooms. A traditional recipe of the Jura mountains and Franche-Comté.
